handoff.salientSummary: Resolved all 8 blocking scrutiny findings and downstream alignment items in `@repo/reservations` (`packages/reservations`): hard-locked `arrived` (and `partially_arrived`/`partially_seated`/`seated`/`finished`), enforced 200/2,000/5,000 expansion budgets, updated `validateConfig` to return `ConfigIssue[]` directly with contiguous `1..party_max` bucket and policy/block checks, implemented `gap: 'skip' | 'after'` and `overlap: 'earlier' | 'later'` in `localToInstant`, added full `BookingChannel` + staff pacing warnings, deadline schemas, template priority sorting, and I1–I8 operation-sequence property tests.
handoff.whatWasImplemented:
Resolved all 8 foundation scrutiny blocking findings and downstream domain contract alignments in `packages/reservations`:
1. Hard-locked `arrived`, `partially_arrived`, `partially_seated`, `seated`, and `finished` in `isBookingHardLocked` (`src/engine/day-state.ts`) so neither `tryRepair` nor `reflowDay` moves an `arrived` reservation (`VAL-FND-007`, I5).
2. Set operation expansion budgets to `MAX_SEARCH_SLOT_EXPANSIONS = 200` per slot in `searchAvailability`, `MAX_BOOK_EXPANSIONS = 2_000` in `assignTables`/`planBooking`, and `MAX_REFLOW_EXPANSIONS = 5_000` in `reflowDay`/`reflow`, returning `status: 'no_fit'` and `budgetExhausted: true` without partial reflow plans when exhausted (`VAL-FND-009`).
3. Updated `src/config/index.ts` and `src/config/validate.ts` with `tableBlockSchema` (`blockSchema`, `blockConfigSchema`), `policyRuleSchema` superRefines, `firstSeatingMin` and `endMin - firstSeatingMin <= 1440` checks, contiguous `1..party_max` turn-time bucket coverage (catching leading, middle, and trailing gaps), policy service reference checks, and direct `ConfigIssue[]` return from `validateConfig` (`VAL-FND-004`).
4. Updated `localToInstant(date, localMin, tz, opts)` in `src/time.ts` to support `opts?: { gap?: 'skip' | 'after'; overlap?: 'earlier' | 'later' }`, returning `null` for `gap: 'skip'` in spring-forward gaps and post-transition instants for `gap: 'after'`, and resolving fall-back folds via `overlap: 'earlier' | 'later'`; updated `resolveServiceWindow` and `searchAvailability` and added tests for `2027-03-14`, `2027-03-28`, `2026-11-01`, `2026-10-25`, 90-min fold (`01:15` -> second `01:45`), `day_start_min` (`240 ± 1`), and `Asia/Riyadh` (`VAL-FND-003`).
5. Extended `BookingChannel` to `'online' | 'native' | 'voice_agent' | 'phone' | 'host' | 'walk_in' | 'waitlist' | 'operator' | 'voice'`, allowed `walk_in_only` tables only for `'walk_in'` and `'waitlist'`, and surfaced pacing breaches as `warnings` on returned slots for staff channels instead of dropping slots (`VAL-FND-006`).
6. Added strict Zod deadline response schemas (`createHoldResponseSchema`, `paymentSessionResponseSchema`, `largePartyRequestResponseSchema`, `waitlistOfferResponseSchema`, `notifyMeOfferResponseSchema`) requiring ISO `expiresAt` and server `now` (`VAL-FND-008`).
7. Added `priority` and `effectiveFrom` to weekly service templates in `src/rules/resolve-services.ts` and sorted templates by latest `effectiveFrom` descending then `priority` descending (`VAL-FND-005`).
8. Extended `verifyDayInvariants` in `src/testing/oracle.ts` to check all invariants I1 through I8 and added random operation sequence generation/execution (`search`, `hold`, `book`, `modify`, `cancel`, `seat`, `finish`, `no_show`, `block`, `settings`, `clock`) in `src/testing/arbitraries.ts` and `src/engine/engine.property.test.ts`, plus aligned `src/messages.ts` quiet hours (`21:00`–`08:00`, move-earlier/skip) and `src/state-machine.ts` with `architecture.md`.
